searchText: With the london hard fork, do I need to send my ethereum to a conversion contract? I am wondering if I need to take my crypto out of my hardware wallet. No basically only a new transaction type was added, this does not influence your balance https://docs.openzeppelin.com/learn Disclosure: I used to be the Community Manager at OpenZeppelin and worked on the Learn Guides Thank you man! I really appreciate it! I there anyone here I can talk to about being scammed? MyCrypto have info on staying safe https://support.mycrypto.com/staying-safe
